topic: Follow current game language in DLL and JSON Mods

languagePolicy.refresh: resolve again on next UI refresh or reopen; existing and disk-reloaded items are in acceptance scope
languagePolicy.authorResponsibility: samples and milestone text provide Chinese and English; authors may supply other official-locale translations; literal strings are not automatically translated
languagePolicy.otherLocales: automatic game-locale CSV lookup uses available translations for all official locales, then English and readable author fallback; complete additional translations and native verification deferred
languagePolicy.nativeAcceptanceBoundary: Current scoped en/zh surfaces passed; no all-languages or all-gameplay-combinations claim.

jsonItemFields: 0.1.72: localizedName, localized descriptions/flavor/custom text, custom type names, module display prose, tooltip source/labels/lines, and container title bind to their owning accepted content pack CSV catalog. Every referenced key requires an en.csv entry.
historicalNativeVerification: 415 en/zh checks on DLL 4238A189B36CEC4C55E88CC70E05E9086EC935412B13CF701671405A12E63274; includes fixture-dispatched supplier pages and actual disk-loaded item/container/machine display. See scoped evidence.
scope: Does not modify the game's locale or Unity string tables. GameLanguage is a DLL API; ordinary JSON item text uses its content-pack CSV catalog. Other framework UI surfaces still require a cross-API English audit.
machineLayoutFields: Standalone layout localizedTitle, liquidInputs[].localizedLabel, output.localizedLabel, localizedBatteryLabel and localizedManualLabel; inline bilingual text, no implicit pack CSV. Default output/battery/manual labels follow game language.
readingLocalization: ReadingApi.Open accepts bilingual title/body/signature; one locale read before native note allocation.
workshopLocalization: WorkshopSnapshot.ForGameLanguage plus optional Localized* fields; legacy English flag retained unless FollowGameLanguage=true.

documentationContext.evidencePolicy: Old native claims are preserved only under historical* fields and do not apply to the current DLL.
